description: This file contains unit tests for the RetrieveSubjects class within the org.eclipse.ditto.signals.commands.policies.query package. It includes tests for immutability, equality/hashCode, exception handling, JSON serialization/deserialization, and object creation methods.

classes.name: RetrieveSubjectsTest
classes.description: Unit test class for the RetrieveSubjects class, testing immutability, equality, exception handling, JSON serialization/deserialization, and object creation methods.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Tests that the RetrieveSubjects class and certain related classes are immutable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies the correctness of hashCode and equals methods for RetrieveSubjects.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullPolicyId
methods.description: Ensures that creating a RetrieveSubjects instance with a null PolicyId throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullPolicyIdString
methods.description: Checks that providing a null string PolicyId raises PolicyIdInvalidException.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithInvalidPolicyId
methods.description: Checks that an invalid PolicyId string leads to PolicyIdInvalidException.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullLabel
methods.description: Verifies that passing null as label throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: toJsonReturnsExpected
methods.description: Tests that the toJson method of RetrieveSubjects produces the expected JSON output.

methods.name: createInstanceFromValidJson
methods.description: Tests that a RetrieveSubjects instance can be created correctly from a valid JSON string.
